title: Vascular cambium & secondary growth
brief: Create a Cannabis stem cross-section sequence from younger primary organization toward secondary thickening. Show the vascular cambium as a lateral meristem producing secondary xylem inward and secondary phloem outward, with tissue age and maturation changing along the stem. Keep proportions study- and developmental-stage dependent rather than drawing one universal ring pattern for every Cannabis stem.

title: Bast fibers & structural support
brief: Create a realistic Cannabis/hemp stem cutaway locating cellulose-rich bast fiber bundles toward the stem periphery and the more lignified xylem-rich inner core. Connect tissue position, wall composition, maturation, and load-bearing function without reducing the stem to an exaggerated single fiber ring or implying identical fiber organization at every age and internode.

title: Cohesion-tension & water potential
brief: Create a soil-root-stem-leaf water-potential gradient showing water entering roots, moving through xylem conduits under tension, and exiting through transpiring leaves. Use arrows, pressure/tension cues, and a continuous water-column concept while making clear that the stem does not actively pump water. Avoid invented Cannabis-specific pressure thresholds or universal transpiration rates.

title: Hydraulic disruption & embolism
brief: Create a side-by-side xylem conduit comparison showing functional water-filled pathways versus gas-filled or physically disrupted conduits and the resulting reduction in hydraulic continuity. Include drought-associated tension, wounding, and freeze-thaw only as general mechanisms where relevant; do not assign unsupported Cannabis cultivar cavitation thresholds or imply every wilt is embolism.
